rules.williams: Williams: a Williams is named as occupier in the 1841 tithe entries or the record names the Williams / Buckler family line. “Occupier” is the schedule’s role-description, not a finding that Williams held no proprietary interest. Which plots were owned, occupied without ownership or held under tenancy remains unresolved; research ongoing.
rules.bute: Bute: the 1841 tithe schedule names the Marquess of Bute in its landowner column for the entries transcribed. That is the schedule’s description, not a complete root-title finding or proof that Bute held every wider estate parcel. Which plots and legal interests Bute held or did not hold remain unresolved; research ongoing.
rules.other: Other: any other landowner, occupier or party.

source: Parcel pins: the 1841 tithe apportionment as transcribed on this site (EV-0215), one pin at the centre of each traced parcel. Owner and occupier fields preserve the schedule’s wording as entered; they do not determine root title or rule out other proprietary interests. The match between these tithe plots and later Parcel A / B / C labels has not been established. Record markers: dated records from this site's evidence pages, compiled into a year-by-year workbook (4 Nov 2026); each marker carries its evidence IDs.
